title: Young Boy Standing Barefoot in Yard, 1951 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot taken in August 1951, showing a young boy standing barefoot in a grassy backyard. He wears a patterned Hawaiian-style short-sleeved shirt and cuffed shorts. Behind him is a tubular metal lawn chair frame and a chain-link fence, offering a candid glimpse into suburban childhood in post-WWII America.
